# Babinom

> A baby-name app for couples. Two people swipe names separately and a name
> becomes a match only when both have liked it, so neither partner sees the
> other's picks and nobody gets talked into a name.

Babinom is a mobile app for iOS and Android. It is not a website tool.

## What it does

- Each partner swipes privately. A name is revealed as a match only when both said yes.
- 115,117 names, all available on the free tier. Paying never unlocks names.
- Names come from national birth-registration data, country by country.
- Meanings and origins in 11 languages: English, Dutch, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic.
- Country and name-length filters are free. Paying removes the daily swipe limit and opens the remaining filters.
- One purchase covers both partners, though each person needs their own account.
- No advertising in the app at any price.

## Get it

- iOS: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6764676399
- Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.daanvos.namenest
- Site: https://babinom.com/
- How it works: https://babinom.com/how-it-works/

## Notes

- Privacy policy: https://babinom.com/privacy/
- AI disclaimer: https://babinom.com/ai-disclaimer/
- Babinom declares no third-party advertising use of data on its App Store privacy label.
- Spelling is "Babinom". Several unrelated apps have similar names.
